title: Ziffr Workspace Export, one line (ziffr.workspace-export/1)
description: One record of a Workspace Export: a file of JSON Lines that holds a whole Workspace for another Installation to import, with no secret, key, Connector link or sealed data. The first line is a header, the last an end record, and a record names only records before it.

oneOf.description: The first line: what the file is and the Workspace's own settings.

ziffr.description: The Ziffr release that wrote the file.

exportedAt.description: A moment in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

workspace.description: The settings of the Workspace an Owner chose.

name.description: text without control characters, line breaks or characters that reverse its direction

timeZone.description: A time zone name such as “Europe/Berlin”.

yearStart.description: The month the Workspace's year starts in (its Fiscal Year); left out, January.

attainmentMethod.description: How Attainment is computed in the Workspace.

id.description: this Group: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

name.description: text without control characters, line breaks or characters that reverse its direction

oneOf.description: A Theme of the Workspace, as a ziffr.theme/1 document.

id.description: this Theme: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

theme.description: A ziffr.theme/1 document, checked by its own schema.

oneOf.description: A person, as an invitation the new Owner chooses to send. Nothing of their account travels.

id.description: this person: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

name.description: text without control characters, line breaks or characters that reverse its direction

role.description: The Workspace Role to invite them with. The Owner of the old Workspace is listed as an admin: the person who imports becomes the Owner.

items.description: the label of the Groups they belong to of this file, listed before this record: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

groups.description: The labels of the Groups they belong to.

oneOf.description: A Metric: its Description, Tags, owner and Submitters. Its values are separate records.

id.description: this Metric: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

key.description: the Metric's key, which a Derived Metric's formula names as {key}: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, unique in the file

metric.description: A ziffr.metric/1 document, checked by its schema with the text rules of the app instead of the Pack's: any text without control or direction characters, a description of up to 2000 characters and Target bounds up to 10^15.

items.description: text without control characters, line breaks or characters that reverse its direction

tags.description: The Tags put on the Metric.

owner.description: the label of the person who owns it of this file, listed before this record: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

items.description: the label of the people who send its values of this file, listed before this record: a label of up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, standing for one record of this file only

submitters.description: The labels of the people who send its values.

dashboard.description: A ziffr.dashboard-template/1 document, checked by its own schema.

The labels of the Metrics that fill one Slot.
